sanskrit_verse:
तथारूढविवादस्य प्रेतस्य व्यवहारिणः
पुत्रेण सोऽर्थः संशोध्यो न तं भोगोऽतिवर्तते
transliteration:
tathārūḍha-vivādasya pretasya vyavahāriṇaḥ
putreṇa sa arthaḥ saṃśodhyo na taṃ bhogo 'tivartate
sph_interpretive_translation: When a dispute has been conclusively settled in life by a deceased person, his son shall ensure completion of that transaction; enjoyment of the benefit does not override this duty.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority transfers through conscious assumption, not inheritance alone
Causation lies in the continuity of dharma-karma alignment beyond physical death
Capacity-based responsibility extends intergenerationally when dharmic completion is pending
Restoration logic requires rectification of incomplete transactions across lifelines
Consciousness alignment demands honoring commitments made in prior states of existence
executable_legal_axioms: IF a decedent was engaged in a legally acknowledged transaction at time of death AND no conclusive resolution occurred THEN the heir capable of assuming dharma-karmic continuity MUST complete said transaction
IF an individual enjoys benefits derived from an unresolved transaction initiated by a predecessor THEN enjoyment constitutes implicit assumption of responsibility for its completion
NO heir may decline responsibility for a transaction initiated by their predecessor IF such refusal disrupts societal dharma-field equilibrium
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving posthumous contractual or karmic obligations, the court must recognize that legal heirs inherit not just property but also the energetic and dharmic weight of unfinished business. The threshold of responsibility is determined not by consent but by capacity to restore dharma-tattva disrupted by the predecessor's incomplete action.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causal disruption persists until completion — thus, what appears as obligation is actually anupūrvaśaḥ, sequential manifestation of unresolved dharma. There is no imposition; there is recognition of already-existing karmic field dynamics. Responsibility aligns proportionally with the capacity to resolve, never to punish.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vyavahara-Shuddhi process wherein heir undertakes guided completion under Dharmic Counsel
Establish Artha-Sambandha RatnaChakram to energetically reconnect fragmented value-exchange fields
Deploy Samvit Adhikara Yantra to realign consciousness blocks preventing natural assumption of duty
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law proceeds from Sanatana Dharma itself, unmediated by human interpretation. Justice flows only toward restoration, never punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Dharma is now restored.
